verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a sandbox environment for exploring the Core API, including a public single-user sandbox and a Quick Start tutorial. The sandbox has dedicated /simulations/cardtransactions/* endpoints for simulating authorizations, reversals and balance inquiries, and it does not communicate with card networks, so nothing touches real-world transactions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience, and explicit evidence that the MCP server/agent tooling can be pointed at the sandbox.
